hook: Anthropic proved VP is not VNP.
hookText: What VP is not VNP means

beats.say: You know the determinant from linear algebra class. Using only addition and multiplication, it can still be computed in polynomial time, for example with Gaussian elimination.
The permanent is like a determinant without any subtraction, and no known method computes it in polynomial time. For a matrix of zeros and ones, it is NP-hard.
Anthropic's proof says no polynomial-size arithmetic circuit can compute it. So for P to equal NP, some trick with AND, OR and NOT would have to beat addition and multiplication.
